title: "assignment_make_palindromic_pattern"
output: html_document
---

Use this tool: https://artockthedino.github.io/lsys.html


Produce a cool image (and submit it here on Canvas) with:

* A starting string that is palindromic. It can just be "A".
* Use uppercase "A", "B", and "C".
* For each of those letters, make a PALINDROMIC replacement rule that contains turns ("+" and "-") and all three letters.
* Use at least 4 iterations.
* Try different turn angles until you find something that looks cool.
* Take a screenshot that shows the image **and the rules**. Submit the screenshot here.
 

The image should have [BILATERAL SYMMETRY](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symmetry_in_biology#Bilateral_symmetry) if the starting string and all replacements are palindromes.
